newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues, distillates down.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues, distillates down.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell by a hefty 2.435 million barrels in the week ending April 2 to 8.229 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
This is the lowest volume seen since at least January 1994.
Middle-distillate stocks also plunged by 1.175 million barrels to 4.953 million barrels.
Middle-distillate stocks also plummetted to its lowest level since at least January 1994.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks slipped marginally by 322,000 barrels to 6.382 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
